# Imperva DNS
> Imperva DNS provides managed authoritative DNS, traffic steering, failover, and DNS security services.

Imperva DNS is part of Imperva’s application security platform and focuses on resilient DNS hosting, routing, availability, and protection capabilities for enterprise domains.

## Product Overview
- [Imperva DNS Overview](https://www.imperva.com/products/dns/): Product overview for managed authoritative DNS, traffic management, and availability features.
- [Application Security](https://www.imperva.com/products/application-security/): Broader Imperva application security platform that includes DNS-related protection capabilities.
- [DDoS Protection](https://www.imperva.com/products/ddos-protection/): Imperva’s DDoS protection offering relevant to DNS and application availability.
- [CDN](https://www.imperva.com/products/cdn/): Content delivery capabilities often paired with DNS traffic routing and performance optimization.

## DNS Security Guides
- [DNS Security Overview](https://docs.imperva.com/bundle/dns-security/page/dns-security-overview.htm): Overview of DNS security capabilities, concepts, and deployment context.
- [Getting Started with DNS Security](https://docs.imperva.com/bundle/dns-security/page/getting-started.htm): Initial setup guidance for onboarding and configuring DNS security services.
- [Managing DNS Zones](https://docs.imperva.com/bundle/dns-security/page/managing-zones.htm): Instructions for creating, updating, and administering DNS zones.
- [Configuring DNS Records](https://docs.imperva.com/bundle/dns-security/page/configuring-records.htm): Guidance for adding and maintaining supported DNS record types.
- [Traffic Steering and Failover](https://docs.imperva.com/bundle/dns-security/page/traffic-steering-and-failover.htm): Configuration guidance for routing policies, health checks, and failover behavior.
- [DNSSEC Configuration](https://docs.imperva.com/bundle/dns-security/page/dnssec.htm): Steps and concepts for enabling and managing DNSSEC protection.
